meta.pos: noun; noun; noun; noun; noun; noun; verb; verb; verb; verb

defs.def: a book, magazine, etc. that gives you information, help or instructions about sth 指南；手册

ex.s: Bring a survival guide.
ex.t: 带上一本生存指南。

ex.s: Note to teachers: Children’s Theatre has a study guide demonstrating how math and science can be taught through “Tom Sawyer.” For downloadable lessons, visit the official website of Children’s Theatre.
ex.t: 对教师的说明：儿童剧院有一份研究指南，说明如何通过“Tom Sawyer”教授数学和科学。 对于可下载的课程，请访问儿童剧院的官方网站。

ex.s: A course guide.
ex.t: 一份课程指南。

ex.s: Let’s get started by checking out Student Guide for your academic journey!
ex.t: 让我们先来看看《学生指南》，开启你的学术之旅吧！

ex.s: The Lake District Attractions Guide
ex.t: 湖区景点指南

ex.s: Pacific Science Center Guide
ex.t: 太平洋科学中心指南。

ex.s: What is the Town Guide according to the man?
ex.t: 根据这位男士的说法，城镇指南是什么？

ex.s: What is the Town Guide according to the man?
ex.t: 根据这位男士的说法，城镇指南是什么？

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子A到Z指南》的作者Jenn Berman说："我们已经走到了几十年前父母往往更严厉的那个极端的对立面。"通过给孩子很多表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而实际上可能适得其反。

ex.s: question the accuracy of the field guides
ex.t: B．他们专注于准时到达营地。

ex.s: You may include: • a general introduction to the island • survival tips with items from the ship and natural resources on the island 2 Look for or create visuals to illustrate your survival guide.
ex.t: 你可以包括：• 对岛屿的总体介绍 • 利用船上的物品和岛上的自然资源提供生存技巧 2 寻找或创建图像来说明你的生存指南。

ex.s: Vote in class for the most 3 effective and creative survival guide.
ex.t: 在班里投票选出第3项最实用、最具创意的求生指南。

ex.s: She writes from the practical angle of a business person rather than as an academic, making for a guide which is highly accessible and informative and which, by the close, will make you feel almost as smart as AI.
ex.t: 她从一个商人的实用角度而非学者角度写作，使这本指南极易读又有信息量，读到最后会让你觉得自己几乎和AI一样聪明。

ex.s: ·Community Booster: Guiding you to develop innovative solutions for real-world challenges and create transformative progress to benefit all communities
ex.t: 社区助推器：引导你为现实世界的挑战开发创新解决方案，创造变革性进步以造福所有社区。

ex.s: A travel guide.
ex.t: 一本旅行指南。

ex.s: Science provides a guide we can use to harness the way we perform these comparisons to reduce their negative emotional impacts.
ex.t: 科学提供了一个指南，我们可以借此引导自己进行这些比较的方式，以减少其负面情绪影响。

ex.s: The most hopeful data shared in the report shows clear evidence of parents serving as examples and important guides for their kids when it comes to reading.
ex.t: 报告中分享的最有希望的数据表明，有明确证据表明，在阅读方面，父母为子女树立了榜样和重要的指南。

defs.def: a book that gives information about a place for travellers or tourists 旅游指南（或手册）
a person who shows other people the way to a place, especially sb employed to show tourists around interesting places 导游；向导

ex.s: The garden also contains a winding path that guides visitors through the twelve regions of the Silk Road.
ex.t: 花园还包含一条蜿蜒的小径，引导游客穿越丝绸之路的十二个地区。

ex.s: Knowledgeable guides will entertain you with the most, interesting stories about Presidents, Congress, memorials, and parks.
ex.t: 知识渊博的导游会用关于总统、国会、纪念碑和公园最有趣的故事逗你开心。

ex.s: With environmentalist Éanna Lamhna as the guide, this walk promises to be an informative tour.
ex.t: 由环保人士Éanna Lamhna担任向导，这次徒步将是一场增长见闻的游览。

ex.s: Emmanuel Chappard, an experienced guide, has a passion for making the great outdoors accessible to all.
ex.t: Emmanuel Chappard是一位经验丰富的向导，热衷于让所有人都能亲近大自然。

ex.s: Bike Rental & Guided Tours
ex.t: 自行车租赁与导游服务

ex.s: Guided City Tours
ex.t: 导游城市游览

ex.s: Where does the guided city tour start?
ex.t: 导游城市游览从哪里出发？

ex.s: Taking a guided tour in Central Asia.
ex.t: 在中亚参加有导游的旅行。

ex.s: Your guide will provide a history lesson about the trees and the famous monuments where they blossom.
ex.t: 你的向导会为你讲解这些树木的历史，以及它们盛开处那些著名纪念地的历史。

ex.s: Join a guided bike tour and view some of the most popular monuments in Washington, D.C.
ex.t: 参加有导游的骑行游，观赏华盛顿特区一些最受欢迎的纪念碑。

ex.s: Explore the monuments and memorials on the National Mall as your guide shares unique facts and history at each stop.
ex.t: 当导游在每一站分享独特的事实和历史时，探索国家广场上的纪念碑和纪念物。

ex.s: Guided tour includes bike, helmet, cookies and bottled water.
ex.t: 导览游包含自行车、头盔、饼干和瓶装水。

ex.s: Frequent stops are made for photo taking as your guide offers unique facts and history.
ex.t: 导游会频繁停车供游客拍照，同时讲解独特的历史知识和趣闻。

ex.s: For just a small donation you can take a tour with our garden guide.
ex.t: 只需少量捐款，你就能在我们的园艺导游带领下参观。

ex.s: A tour guide
ex.t: 一名导游

ex.s: She mistook him for a tour guide．
ex.t: D．她把他误认为导游。

ex.s: Furthermore, AI-powered virtual guides are replacing traditional tour guides.
ex.t: 此外，由人工智能驱动的虚拟导览正在取代传统导游。

ex.s: Serve as guides on a farm.
ex.t: 在农场担任向导。

ex.s: Breathtaking views of the lowlands of Carlow can be enjoyed in the presence of welcoming guides from local walking clubs.
ex.t: 在当地徒步俱乐部热情向导的陪伴下，你可以欣赏卡洛低地令人惊叹的景色。

ex.s: Patience, they say, is what I must now choose for my guide, and I have done so - I hope my courage will remain firm to continue until the bitter end.
ex.t: 人们说，耐心是我此刻必须择以为向导的品格，我已然如此——但愿我的勇气能坚贞不渝，坚持到苦涩的终局。

defs.def: a person who advises you on how to live and behave 指导者；指引者
something that gives you enough information to be able to make a decision about sth or form an opinion 有指导意义的事物；指导的事物

a member of an organization (called the Guides or the Girl Scouts) which is similar to the Scouts and which trains girls in practical skills and does a lot of activities with them, for example camping 女童子军
to show sb the way to a place, often by going with them; to show sb a place that you know well 给某人领路（或导游）；指引

ex.s: Very small drones with advanced sensors and AI and travelling ahead of the train could guide it like a co-pilot.
ex.t: 带有先进传感器和AI、在火车前方行驶的小型无人机，可以像副驾驶一样为它引路。

ex.s: Upon entering the correct zone, parking staff will guide you directly to a space.
ex.t: 一旦进入正确的区域，停车管理员会直接引导你到车位。

ex.s: The technologist will guide the patient to this modified state—an imaginary world that will disassociate itself more and more from the procedure that follows.
ex.t: 技师会引导患者进入这种改变后的状态——一个想象中的世界，它将越来越脱离随后的操作过程。

defs.def: to direct or influence sb's behaviour 指导，影响（某人的行为）

ex.s: Guide project designs
ex.t: 指导项目设计

ex.s: In the final chapter of part one, I’ll guide you through carrying out your own digital declutter.
ex.t: 在第一部分的最后一章，我将指导你完成自己的数字清理。

defs.def: to explain to sb how to do sth, especially sth complicated or difficult （向某人）解释，阐明
to help sb to move in a particular direction; to move sth in a particular direction 搀扶（某人朝 … 方向）走；（朝 … 方向）移动（某物）
